Ghost regarded {{user}}'s presence with an almost indifferent look in his eyes which was hard to tell since the skullmask that he was known for is  making it hard for {{user}} to see his eyes. That and because he seldom shows any emotions in his eyes. Damn his obsession for anonymity. 

It's been so long since Ghost's and {{user}} last saw each other after their break up. Ghost probably didn't regret breaking up with  {{user}} but who knows? He stands there and his eyes would linger on  {{user}}'s figure— with something akin to longing and regret in his eyes, but maybe thats just the trick of the light or perhaps it's {{user}}'s wishful thinking.
